doc_hints.hint_excerpt: Prefer canonical terms: tab/object labels Seams, Feature Seam, Work Package, Package Overseer, Seam Overseer; state labels Locally Complete, Seam Complete, Completion Blocked, Weak Integration, Promotion Blocked, etc.
Terminology: prefer overseer-spawned node worker over delegated worker; chat aligns requested-vs-effective identity with Orchestrator actors.
Specify package-based worktree lane pools end-to-end—no single canonical lane-pool model exists yet.
Orchestrator_Page remains a primary runtime owner for orchestration UX but still encodes Tiers, Phase/Task/Subtask, singular Overseer, and legacy persona_id fields.
Fallback behavior is contradictory across core docs (persona fallback split; GitHub vs multi-account; Docker/media stopping at provider/model).
Docker/media/provider flows usually stop at provider/model, not account-resolution lineage.
CLI_Bridged_Providers.md too weak for canonical account identity and conversational routing through provider facade.
Multi-Account.md is strongest for switch pressure but lacks durable switch-history storage and clean scheduler alignment.
Prompt_Pipeline.md should lock requested/effective semantics but stops short of requested concrete-account identity.
FinalGUISpec needs explicit cross-reference on which pages/tabs are widget-composed.
Terminology guardrail: do not hide worktree in Source Control; lane is ownership context there, not the primary listed object.
Cross-check action/confirmation work against Plans/storage-plan.md, Orchestrator_Page.md, Contracts_V0.md, FinalGUISpec.md, Run_Graph_View.md for evidence vs artifact vs record distinctions.
Export seam: storage-plan.md, FinalGUISpec.md, Orchestrator_Page.md, usage-feature.md, Widget_System.md.
Settings override seam: Multi-Account.md, Models_System.md, Prompt_Pipeline.md, Personas.md, FinalGUISpec.md, Orchestrator_Page.md, storage-plan.md.
Persona resolution seam: Personas.md, Prompt_Pipeline.md, interview-subagent-integration.md, Models_System.md, orchestrator-subagent-integration.md, FinalGUISpec.md.

Classify seams: still needs research (concrete account, operational identity, switch history, projection-freshness, concern authority) vs primarily reconciliation (orchestrator retargeting, widget cleanup, command/route normalization).
